primary_finding.label: Right apical pneumothorax
primary_finding.rationale: A thin visceral pleural line is visible in the right apex with absent lung markings peripheral to it. No mediastinal shift.

key_observations: Thin white visceral pleural line in the right apex. Lung markings absent peripheral to the line. Costophrenic angles are sharp. No subcutaneous emphysema.
teaching_point: On an erect PA film, small pneumothoraces are easiest to spot at the apex. Look carefully for the pleural line; expiratory films accentuate small PTX.
